reads_as: A bandage-wrapped 'Hellraiser' face beside huge white-then-red text screaming THE WORST over rising flames.
layout_map: Background is a dark cyan engineering-graph grid; orange flames lick up the bottom-right quadrant (cells 11-12, 15-16). A pale bandage-wrapped pinhead face fills the left edge cells 1/5/9, center ~x140,y180, occupying roughly the left 20% of frame. Headline is two rows top-right: row1 'This is the' in white Inter caps, baseline ~y50 spanning cells 2-4; row2 'WORST..' in bold red, baseline ~y115, large, spanning cells 6-8. Text is right-aligned in the upper-right zone away from the face. No stat or badge.
why_it_works: The unfinished red 'WORST..' plus a horror face withholds WHAT is worst, and the flames signal catastrophe — pure dread-curiosity.
mimic_for: a strong-opinion takedown where something popular is declared the worst / most painful thing in the field
title: Why Full Stack Is THE WORST Thing To Happen To Software Engineers

reads_as: A crying wojak face surrounded by flames under the headline 'The Agile Experience' with Agile in red.
layout_map: Dark cyan graph-grid background with orange flames burning across the entire bottom band (cells 9-16) and creeping up both sides. A line-art crying wojak face sits center-frame, center ~x600,y400, cells 6/7/10/11, filling the lower-middle ~30% of frame. Single headline row across the top: 'The Agile Experience' in white Inter caps with the middle word 'Agile' in bold red, baseline ~y45, spanning full width cells 1-4. No stat or number; the flames are the device along with the red accent word.
why_it_works: Naming a buzzword ('Agile') in danger-red over a sobbing face engulfed in flames frames a relatable process as suffering — empathy plus dread.
mimic_for: a satirical 'what it's really like' take on a hyped methodology, process, or workflow that's secretly miserable
title: How Every "Agile" Sprint Turns into a CHAOTIC MESS

title: Programming Truths NOBODY Told Me...
